claims.evidence: Witness report describes thick, knobby tires.
Witness only notes a headlight/reflector area and training-wheel support; no list of accessories shown.
No purchase date/receipt or wear timeline evidence reported.
Witness did not report gear presence/condition or brake type/condition.
Witness did not mention rust inspection details.
No brand/model or part-by-part originality evidence reported.

risks.risk: Wheel size unknown (16/18/20 inches etc.), which strongly affects value for kids bikes.
risks.proof: A clear shot showing the wheel size marking (e.g., 16/18/20) or a tape-measure photo from axle to axle/diameter.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely kids-bike tier for the unknown size.

risks.risk: Brake type and condition not confirmed (pads/cables/rotor if any).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear brakes (pad/lever/cable) plus a short clip squeezing brakes to show firm stopping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'brakes need checking' (worst-case: pads/cables worn).

risks.risk: Gears/drivetrain not confirmed (single-speed vs gears; chain wear; shifting).
risks.proof: Photo of the drivetrain/gear area (rear cassette/derailleur or shifter) and a clip showing shifting through gears smoothly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as single-speed or 'gear system unverified' at the lower end.

risks.proof: Full-frame walkaround photos: top tube, down tube, head tube, seat tube, and both sides; include any welds/repairs.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case 'possible frame wear' until inspected.

risks.risk: Tire condition details unknown beyond visible tread (sidewall damage, tubed vs tubeless).
risks.proof: Close-up of both tires’ sidewalls and tread depth, plus a photo of valve/tube area if tubed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'tires may need replacement soon' if sidewall/tread depth can’t be verified.

risks.risk: Training wheels mounting/adjustability and security not confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo showing the training-wheel brackets and adjustment points; a clip lightly rocking the bike to show no looseness.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'training wheels may be loose/needs adjustment'.

risks.risk: Accessories completeness not confirmed (seller says complete accessories, but not shown).
risks.proof: Photo inventory laid out: bell, reflectors, kickstand, pump, tools, manuals—everything included.
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming extra accessories beyond what is clearly visible.

proof_requests: Show the wheel size marking (16/18/20 inches) clearly.
Close-up photos of front and rear brakes (type and condition) and a short stopping clip.
Photos of the gear system (shifter + rear sprocket/derailleur) and a clip shifting through all gears.
Full walkaround frame photos (both sides) to check for cracks/dents/repairs.
Close-ups of tire sidewalls and tread depth; confirm tubed vs tubeless.
Photos of training-wheel brackets showing secure mounting and adjustability; include a rocking test clip.
Lay out and photograph all included accessories to verify 'complete accessories'.
response.reason: The witness can confirm it is a kids bicycle with thick knobby tires and training-wheel support, but key value drivers (wheel size, brake/drivetrain condition, and accessory completeness) are not verifiable from the report. Without those, any worst-case pricing would be too uncertain.
